item.title: Used bookstore searches for owner of antique photo album lost at Milwaukee Airport
item.description: The album was left behind for months in the terminal's lost and found before airport staff brought it to the bookstore for safekeeping. The post Used bookstore searches for owner of antique photo album lost at Milwaukee Airport appeared first on WPR.

item.title: Wisconsin US Sen. Tammy Baldwin speaks out against GOP bill to restrict voting
item.description: Democratic U.S. Sen. Tammy Baldwin said Friday she adamantly opposes a GOP bill moving through Congress that would tighten voting access nationwide. The post Wisconsin US Sen. Tammy Baldwin speaks out against GOP bill to restrict voting appeared first on WPR.

item.title: La Crosse group offers care packages to Hmong elders who fear ICE enforcement
item.description: One community leader says many elders struggle with English, making them fearful of interacting with immigration agents despite being U.S. citizens. The post La Crosse group offers care packages to Hmong elders who fear ICE enforcement appeared first on WPR.

item.title: Dual enrollment participation remains low in Milwaukee
item.description: Students have a chance to save money on college credits and the time it would take them to complete a degree. But studies show opportunities are not consistent across Wisconsin or demographics. The post Dual enrollment participation remains low in Milwaukee appeared first on WPR.

item.title: Judge sanctions Kenosha County DA for AI use in court
item.description: A judge has sanctioned Kenosha County District Attorney Xavier Solis for using artificial intelligence in court filings. The post Judge sanctions Kenosha County DA for AI use in court appeared first on WPR.

item.title: The rise of home fermentation
item.description: A leading food author revealed to WPR's "The Larry Meiller Show" that fermenting at home is safe, fun, inexpensive and tremendously healthful. The post The rise of home fermentation appeared first on WPR.

item.title: ‘Writing Your Life’ class helps Wisconsin seniors record their memories
item.description: Everyone has a life story to tell, but many people struggle to document their lives. “Writing Your Life” workshop helps people record their memories. The post ‘Writing Your Life’ class helps Wisconsin seniors record their memories appeared first on WPR.

item.title: Wisconsin’s Ben Loomis will compete for Team USA in his 3rd Winter Olympic Games
item.description: Ben Loomis is one of just two skiers representing Team USA in the nordic combined skiing competition at the 2026 Winter Olympics in Milan, Italy this February. The Norwegian sport blends ski jumping with a cross country skiing race. There are two individual events and one team event. The post Wisconsin’s Ben Loomis will compete for Team USA in his 3rd Winter Olympic Games appeared first on WPR.

item.title: Lawsuit against Madison over uncounted ballots will move forward
item.description: Judge David Conway rejected Madison's attempt to have the case thrown out. The post Lawsuit against Madison over uncounted ballots will move forward appeared first on WPR.

item.title: UW-Madison saw 17 percent cut to federal research funds in Trump’s first year
item.description: The University of Wisconsin-Madison saw a 17 percent decrease in federal research funding since the start of President Donald Trump’s second term, according to outgoing Chancellor Jennifer Mnookin.
